lines.text: Jensen Huang is back! Nvidia just rehired its CEO.
Eleven days after he resigned. The board voted unanimously, after input from top U.S. officials.
lines.say: Eleven days after he resigned. The board voted unanimously, after input from top U.S. officials.

lines.text: And the stock went to the moon! Up about thirty percent in one day!

card.title: STILL ONGOING
card.body: the board's own probe into the reported spy allegations.

lines.text: So why did my brain flip twice in two weeks?
That's overreaction. We swing too hard on fresh news.
In 1985, De Bondt and Thaler found the stocks investors dumped hardest later beat the market's darlings, by about twenty-five percent.
lines.say: In nineteen eighty-five, De Bont and Thaler found the stocks investors dumped hardest later beat the market's darlings, by about twenty-five percent.

card.title: DE BONDT & THALER · 1985
card.body: Past "losers" beat past "winners" by ~25% over the next 3 years.

lines.text: Big news feels like the whole story. It's usually just the latest chapter.
